title: Locus of control as a factor in the structural organization of professionally important qualities of programmers
abstract: Context and relevance. One of the most important personal qualities — locus of control is studied in the context of its activity status and significant role — as a professionally important quality. Objective. The research is aimed at identifying and explaining the specifics of the relationship between the locus of control and the effectiveness of information activity and the structural organization of its subject determinants, as well as its impact on them. Hypothesis. The study is based on the hypothesis that there exists an initial link—characterized by a deterministic influence—between the locus of control and the structural organization of the core professionally significant quality of programmers, who serve as the most representative examples of the subject-information class of activities. Methods and materials. The study design included the implementation of the methodology of structural-psychological analysis, the method of polar groups, and a set of psychodiagnostic methods aimed at determining the individual measure of the locus of control, as well as the basic professionally important qualities. The sample included a total of 288 people (215 men and 73 women; aged 18 to 58 years; M = 32.82, SD = 3.39); IT specialists (programmers). Results. There is a correlation between the individual measure of internality and the performance of programmers, which is represented at the level of a tendency, indicating a complex and indirect influence on performance. The locus of control has a priority influence on the degree of structural organization of professionally important qualities, and through it, that is, indirectly and significantly on the effectiveness of activity in general. This influence manifests itself in the fact that the measure of integration — the structural organization of these qualities in internals is significantly higher and, therefore, their total functional potential is also greater. Conclusions. The hypothesis about the existence of a significant deterministic influence of the locus of control on the structural organization of the main professionally important qualities of information activity has been verified. It has been proven that the integration of the professionally important qualities of programmers' activity is significantly higher among internals than among externals; this pattern is one of the main factors that determine the differences in the effectiveness of the activity itself.
